historical_references.context: Mahabharata is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India, the other being the Ramayana. It relates the story of the Kurukshetra War, a great battle between two groups of cousins, the Kurus and the Pandavas, over the throne of Hastinapura.

historical_references.reference: Arjuna, also known as Arjay, was a significant character in the Hindu epic, the Mahabharata. He was a great warrior and a devotee of Lord Krishna. Arjuna's story is recounted in the Bhagavad Gita, a 700-verse Hindu scripture.
